law: GAIA NEVER GOES DOWN. Infinite uptime. Watchdog resurrects dead organs. Multiple paths in.

uptime_layers.layer_1_boot: biomeOS-AMALGAM-BOOT.bat in Windows Startup folder. Gaia starts when PC turns on.
uptime_layers.layer_2_watchdog: BOOT-AMALGAM.bat now has watchdog loop. Every 60 seconds checks :3143, :80, :9878. If dead, resurrected.
uptime_layers.layer_3_lan: Any device on LAN can reach 192.168.4.147:3143/mesh directly. No internet needed.
uptime_layers.layer_4_gateway: gateway.js on :80/:443 routes all domains to gaia-http.js. Port forward on router.
uptime_layers.layer_5_rss: RSS cached by every reader. Content survives even if Gaia sleeps.
uptime_layers.layer_6_pwa: mesh.html is PWA installable. Once cached on phone, works offline (airgap).
uptime_layers.layer_7_tor: FUTURE: Tor hidden service (.onion) punches through NAT. No port forward needed. Always reachable.
uptime_layers.layer_8_sporegate_dns: sporegate (.3) runs DNS for LAN. Backup path.

result: NEVER DOWN. 8 layers of uptime. If one fails, others hold.
